message: Hi, I'm interested in the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty. I can do $35,000 total for both. Can you work with that?

Thanks for your interest! The T45 Utility is a great fit for 10-50 acre work, and the 3-year extended warranty gives you parts and labor coverage well beyond the standard year. $35,000 is too low for that package (list is $44,400 combined), but I can come down to $42,800 for the T45 with the extended warranty.
Heartland Tractor Supply posts the T45 at $40,750 with no haggling. My budget is $37,500 for the T45 plus the 3-year warranty, and I'm ready to pay today. Can you meet $37,500?

I appreciate that you're ready to buy today. I can't verify other dealers' pricing, but I want to earn your business. $37,500 doesn't work for the T45 with the 3-year extended warranty. I can do $40,200 for the package. That covers 45 hp, 4WD, the Cat I/II hitch, the 540 PTO, and full parts-and-labor coverage for 3 years beyond the standard warranty.
We're getting closer. I can stretch to $38,000 for the T45 + 3-year warranty, payment in full right now.

Thanks for moving up. I'm glad we're getting close. I can meet you partway at $39,200 for the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full today. That's $5,200 off the combined list price, and you get full parts-and-labor coverage through year four.
Let's close it: $38,500 for the T45 + 3-year warranty and I'll check out immediately.
You've got a deal. $38,500 for the T45 Utility with the 3-year extended warranty, paid in full at checkout. Thanks for your business. You'll be issued an offer ID to complete payment.
